name: Wall Push-Up
description: The gentlest push-up: lean into a wall with straight arms, then bend your elbows to bring your chest toward it and push back.
setup: Stand an arm's length from a wall.
Put your hands flat on the wall at chest height, fingers pointing up.
cues: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Elbows stay close to your sides.
Close the gap to the wall as far as you comfortably can, then push back slowly.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Arms straight
keyframes.cue: Hands on the wall at chest height, body straight.

keyframes.name: Bend your elbows
keyframes.cue: Lower your chest toward the wall.
